subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw add an automatic repair for corrupted Dashboard key to transcript mappings, or limit the first fix to diagnostics until a safe matching rule is proven with redacted fixtures?
rationale: The code path to inspect is clear, but the product policy for choosing a preserved orphan trajectory or transcript is unsafe to infer automatically without maintainer intent.

options.title: Diagnostic-first repair policy
options.body: Add a non-destructive doctor/dashboard diagnostic with fixture-backed matching and only enable relinking when evidence is unambiguous.

options.title: Automatic relink on startup
options.body: Attempt to repair corrupted Dashboard rows during gateway startup, accepting higher risk of attaching a key to the wrong preserved history.

options.title: Wait for reporter fixture only
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until a redacted affected store and transcript set is available.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic-first repair policy
recommendation.body: Add a non-destructive doctor/dashboard diagnostic with fixture-backed matching and only enable relinking when evidence is unambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent transcript reader and canonical read-scope refactors put this owner closest to the current Dashboard history resolution path.
